description: This file contains implementation of a test stub server for IPC communication, including client connection handling, event sending, and server thread management, primarily used for testing IPC mechanisms in the Rialto project.

classes.name: ServerStub
classes.description: A test stub server class for IPC communication, managing client connections, event dispatching, and server thread lifecycle.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnection events, resets connection state, and notifies waiting threads.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles new client connections, stores client info, exports services if mock is set, and notifies waiting threads.

methods.name: ServerStub
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server stub, optionally with a mock module.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the server, sets up socket, and starts the server processing thread.

methods.name: ~ServerStub
methods.description: Destructor that joins the server thread if active.

methods.name: sendSingleVarEvent
methods.description: Sends a single variable event to the connected client, waiting for connection if necessary.

methods.name: sendMultiVarEvent
methods.description: Sends a multi-variable event to the connected client, waiting for connection if necessary.
